name: Extra Field Suite
description: Provides a plugin type for extra fields that look like real fields, but do not store data.
project_description: Extra Field Suite (efs) is a developer framework that turns Drupal's extra pseudo-fields into a discoverable plugin type. Each 'Extra field formatter' plugin (annotation @ExtraFieldFormatter, discovery directory Plugin/efs/Formatter, service plugin.manager.efs.formatters) renders a display-only or form-only element that behaves like a real field on the Manage display / Manage form display screens but stores no field data. Placements are stored as 'extra_field' config entities and injected via hook_entity_extra_field_info(), hook_entity_view_alter() and hook_form_alter(). The module ships stock plugins (Entity label, Field mirror, Entity reference field, View, Tokenizer Wysiwyg, Entity form display) and supports per-display, per-mode and per-entity-type configuration through the Field UI, including a Layout Builder override block. It conflicts with and must not be used alongside the Extra Field module.
